chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bahr, from Hariz, who said:
I said to Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام: May a junub apply oil and then perform ghusl? He said: No.
So the correct way to understand this report is that it indicates a type of karahah, in accordance with what we mentioned in the narration of al-Sakkuni.

key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.الْخَبَرِ: the report or hadith under discussion
key_terms.يَدَّهِنُ: applies oil or ointment to the body

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked for a junub to apply oil before performing ghusl?
ai.summary: This report addresses the ruling on a person in janabah applying oil before performing ghusl. Although the Imam عليه السلام answers negatively, the compiler clarifies that the report is to be understood as indicating karahah rather than absolute prohibition.
